title: ZCC SDK calls in legacy-client mode routed to the ZIA client

prose.text: This is a defect in the Go SDK's legacy-client mode, which matters to code that calls the SDK directly with legacy ZCC credentials. {{generic-legacy-path-targets-zia}} {{zcc-services-use-generic-path}} {{legacy-zcc-reads-fail-or-misroute}}

checks.do: Whether a failing ZCC call comes from a direct SDK script in legacy mode rather than the provider, before blaming this defect.

generic-legacy-path-targets-zia.statement: In legacy-client mode, the SDK's generic `Read` and `Delete` hand the call to the ZIA legacy client, not the ZCC one. The ZCC-specific request path does use the ZCC legacy client.

evidence.after: func (c *Client) Read(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, o interface{}) error {

zcc-services-use-generic-path.statement: Several ZCC services read or delete through the generic path: device details, trusted networks (v2), notification templates, ZIA posture, forwarding profiles, and web policies.

legacy-zcc-reads-fail-or-misroute.statement: So for a direct SDK caller in legacy mode, these ZCC reads and deletes fail when only a ZCC legacy client is configured, and go to the ZIA legacy client when both are.
legacy-zcc-reads-fail-or-misroute.conditions: Only in the SDK's legacy-client mode.

upstream.note: Affects direct SDK callers only; the ZCC Terraform provider does not use legacy mode.

zcc-provider-oneapi-only.statement: The ZCC Terraform provider is built for the OneAPI flow only, so it does not normally inherit this defect. The SDK still reads `ZSCALER_USE_LEGACY_CLIENT` from the environment and the provider does not override it, so setting that variable would switch the provider into legacy mode. The provider never builds a legacy client and the SDK then skips OneAPI authentication, so every ZCC call, on the ZCC request path as well as the generic one, returns `errLegacyClientNotSet`.

quotes: supports the V3 OneAPI flow — the legacy ZCC V2 client

evidence.after: func (c *Client) Read(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, o interface{}) error {

zcc-provider-oneapi-only.conditions: The provider's intent is quoted; the environment override is in the SDK configuration. Widened from 'these calls fail': the provider passes no legacy client to `NewOneAPIClient`, which authenticates only when `UseLegacyClient` is false, so the ZCC request path fails too. Traced, not run.
